raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 144 txn_ids delivered twice, and the copies are identical in every column, including batch_id and ingest_ts. Silver does not deduplicate, so the POSTED ones (136) show up as duplicate keys and inflate counts and totals in all the gold tables. Deduplicating exact copies in silver_transactions is safe.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
